title: rework-presubmit-toolchain-and-dep-rollup
author: Elena Morales
description: Summary: Rework presubmit toolchain and introduce a dependency rollup action to reduce CI noise and speed developer feedback. Motivation: our presubmit lanes have grown fragile and slow due to fragmented toolchain bootstraps (legacy Makefiles + ad-hoc scripts + multiple container images) and an increasing tide of single-dep PRs from Dependabot. This PR consolidates the presubmit entrypoints, replaces the legacy make-based bootstrap with a lightweight Go runner (ci-helix), adds dep-rollup-action to batch low-risk dependency updates into weekly rollup PRs, and updates docs and release hooks. Changeset: 1) introduce ci/helix-runner: a small Go binary that coordinates staged presubmit shards, caches toolchains, and exposes a graceful shutdown for flaky runners; 2) migrate lint/test job definitions to use the new runner and remove duplicated shell bootstraps in .github/workflows; 3) add .github/actions/dep-rollup-action which aggregates Dependabot PRs, resolves version matrix conflicts using a curated allowlist, and opens a single weekly rollup PR per language ecosystem; 4) remove top-level Makefile bootstraps and translate targets into workspace scripts with explicit toolchain manifests; 5) update release automation to run an early artifact-sign step so that staging validation can use signed artifacts; 6) docs: presubmit-runner.md and dep-rollup.md with rollout notes and rollback instructions. Risk & rollout: feature guarded behind a repo-level opt-in flag (ci.presubmit.v2) and rollout device set to gradual: enable on non-critical repos for 48h, then full cutover. Performance: average presubmit runtime for JS/TS lint shards reduced 28% in local perf harness; CI queue wait time reduced from median 4m to 2.1m due to better runner reuse. Why different from previous CI work: instead of only splitting jobs or tuning cache keys, this change consolidates the toolchain bootstrap path and treats dependency churn as a first-class workload by batching updates upstream, minimizing noise and merge collisions. See linked Linear tickets for acceptance criteria and test matrix.

notes_for_oncall: If presubmit runners start leaking processes, set CI_HELIX_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT to 5s as emergency mitigation. To disable automated rollups temporarily set .github/dep-rollup-config.yml: enabled: false. See docs/presubmit-runner.md for rollback steps.
